item.title: Oregon Man Accused of Hiding Mother’s Body in Freezer to Keep Collecting Her Social Security Checks
item.description: A 68-year-old Portland man, who was frightened that he would become homeless, hid his mother’s body in the kitchen freezer so that he could keep collecting her Social Security checks.
